working_definition: Author cell type 'dorsal rim area' of the Fly Cell Atlas (Li et al. 2022; adult head, 2 sensory neuron nuclei): photoreceptors of the dorsal rim ommatidia of the retina. Authors' term FBbt:00111065 is a retinal region.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Any eye photoreceptor cell (FBbt:00006009) that is part of some dorsal margin ommatidium (FBbt:02000000).

justification: The authors' term is a region (dorsal part of the retina, a single row of dorsal margin ommatidia); the report states the cells are photoreceptors of the dorsal rim. The cell-level equivalent is dorsal margin photoreceptor cell (photoreceptor part of a dorsal margin ommatidium).

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Dorsal part of the retina, consisting of a single row of (dorsal margin) ommatidia.
Photoreceptor cell of the compound eye.

recommendation: Map to dorsal margin photoreceptor cell; region term kept as alternative.
